name: 24246-loraprefill-30ba3b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 -- ungated, ~61 GB -- with ONE LoRA adapter on top: `yushengsu/lora-diff-Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507`, r=32, lora_alpha=32, `target_modules: all-linear`, published as an HF *dataset* repo (1.98 GB, fp32).
parallelism: TP=4 over four GPUs of one node. DP=1, EP=1, PP=1, no DP attention, no router and no external cache tier. ~15 GB of weights per rank plus ~0.5 GB per adapter pool slot.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, bf16, no quantization_config: 48 layers, hidden 2048, vocab 151936, 32 query over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 routed experts top-8 with moe_intermediate_size 768, every layer sparse.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 3840 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed 42; ~3072 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: exactly 2048 prompt tokens in and exactly 128 out, `temperature: 0.0` and `ignore_eos: true` so every request generates exactly 128. Every request is served through the adapter and none through the base model.
purpose: A specialized document-analysis assistant on a 30-billion-parameter model with one adapter, serving 128 concurrent long-prompt, short-answer requests across four GPUs.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 4

# HAZARD: `lora-paths` must name a local directory. The adapter is published as an HF *dataset*
# repo, and a non-directory value is resolved with `snapshot_download(path)` as a model repo,
# which 404s. The snapshot must be present at the path below.
enable-lora: true
lora-paths: ["my_lora=${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/lora-diff-Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507"]
max-lora-rank: 32
experts-shared-outer-loras: true

# LOAD-BEARING. Every request reaches the adapter through the request body's `lora_path: my_lora`
# (scenario.json, backend extras). served-model-name is left to the serving layer: this engine
# refuses a colon in it, so the `<name>:my_lora` model-string form cannot be served. A request
# without `lora_path` is answered from the base weights at rc=0.

max-loras-per-batch: 2
moe-runner-backend: triton
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: 16384

# Matches the 128 in-flight streams. If `streams` rises above 128, this moves with it, or decode
# silently leaves the graph.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
